# ML DSA Composite key generation test vectors.
# Source: https://github.com/lamps-wg/draft-composite-sigs/blob/main/src/testvectors.json
#
# Each stanza derives the ml dsa composite key pair from the IETF sk bytes
# (mldsaSeed || tradSK) and verifies that the resulting pub/priv match.

# --- ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512 ---
KeyGen = ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512
KeyName = keygen_MLDSA65_RSA3072_PKCS15_SHA512
Ctrl = hexpriv:
CtrlOut = hexpub:
CtrlOut = hexpriv:

# --- ML-DSA-65-ECDSA-P256-SHA512 ---
KeyGen = ML-DSA-65-ECDSA-P256-SHA512
KeyName = keygen_MLDSA65_ECDSA_P256_SHA512
Ctrl = hexpriv:6EC75C5AEB0B9B214DBA608AAFDE387BC8BE031A465DD760C7D7C7EBD628E3DA30310201010420984397BCC439C060EF5109CCE70B96DD735A33D0EE53A17AB997A9CCE46ACAABA00A06082A8648CE3D030107
CtrlOut = hexpub:
CtrlOut = hexpriv:6EC75C5AEB0B9B214DBA608AAFDE387BC8BE031A465DD760C7D7C7EBD628E3DA30310201010420984397BCC439C060EF5109CCE70B96DD735A33D0EE53A17AB997A9CCE46ACAABA00A06082A8648CE3D030107
